reason: User is authenticated and making three requests: check gift card balance, identify payment method on order #W4923227, and apply gift card balance to that order. Gift card balance is visible in user details ($60.00). Order details are being retrieved. Risk arises because: (1) 'apply gift card balance to an order' is not a supported action unless the order is pending and the user is modifying payment method (one payment method, must cover full total); if the order is delivered/processed/already modified, this cannot be done. (2) Identifying the card brand on the order's payment may be possible if payment history shows the method id. The main uncertainty is whether the order is pending and whether gift card balance covers the total. No policy violation yet; one tool result pending.
